input: Book a stand-up paddleboarding lesson this summer

gold.taskTitle: Book a Stand-Up Paddleboarding Lesson This Summer
gold.taskDescription: Find and book a stand-up paddleboarding lesson for this summer.

questions.title: What city or body of water do you want to learn in?
questions.description: Identify the specific location where the user wants to take the lesson.

questions.title: Is this your very first time on a paddleboard?
questions.description: Determine the user's prior experience level to find an appropriate beginner or intermediate lesson.

questions.title: Are you booking this lesson just for yourself?
questions.description: Find out if the booking is solo, for a couple, a group, or a family with kids.

questions.title: Do you have a target month or date range in mind?
questions.description: Narrow down the summer window — for example, June, July, or a specific vacation week.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the lesson?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with to filter suitable providers.

questions.title: Do you prefer ocean, lake, or river conditions?
questions.description: Clarify the type of water environment the user wants to learn in, as it affects school selection.

questions.title: Do you need equipment rental included in the booking?
questions.description: Find out if the user owns any gear or needs the school to provide a board and paddle.
